name: UTA Artist Space
about_text: UTA Artist Space is an exhibition venue founded in 2016 in Beverly Hills, California, in a space designed by artist Ai Weiwei. Growing out of United Talent Agency's broader work representing creative talent, the gallery presents interdisciplinary exhibitions that often bring together visual artists with figures from music, fashion, and entertainment. Its Los Angeles program has hosted shows by artists such as Derrick Adams, Larry Clark, Petra Cortright, Conrad Egyir, and Arcmanoro Niles, among others. UTA Artist Space also operates a second location in Atlanta, connected to UTA's offices there, positioning it as a full-service space spanning entertainment, music, sports, and fine art. The program spans painting, drawing, photography, and mixed media, frequently drawing on the agency's cross-industry roster of talent.
program_focus: contemporary painting and works on paper
